_comment: Audio licence provenance. Background music is the most common cause of YouTube Content ID claims. Every bed used in a published video must have a recorded, verifiable licence. The compliance gate reads this file.
_provenance: All beds are synthesised from scratch by scripts/audio/generate-beds.sh using ffmpeg noise generators only. The script is the licence: deterministic, reproducible, no third-party material at any stage.
_halal: Natural ambience only. No instruments, tones, melody or beat. A sustained three-tone drone and a 72bpm low pulse were removed for this reason and must not be reintroduced.
_archived: Six files of unverified origin are in public/sounds/_archive-unverified/. See DO-NOT-USE.md there.

tracks.downloaded_from: Not downloaded. Synthesised from filtered noise with ffmpeg.
tracks.halal_note: Natural ambience from filtered noise only. No instrument, tone, melody or beat. Amplitude modulation is 0.1-0.3Hz, reproducing natural wind and water swell, far below anything perceived as rhythm.
tracks.notes: Original synthesised work. Reproducible via scripts/audio/generate-beds.sh. No Content ID exposure.
